name: Mirror World
source:
Esperanza is a young girl who loves fantasy, and gets easily absorbed in the stories she reads. One afternoon during recess at school, she gets so into the story, she's suddenly brought somewhere else. A mysterious girl with no name approaches, explaining that this place - the Mirror World - is her imagination.

Make choices as Esperanza while she explores her imagination, gets to know the mystery girl better, and develops her own stories throughout the years. Of course, reality must be faced at some point, right?

[From [url=https://cursedcreator.itch.io/mirror-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃斯佩兰萨是一个热爱幻想的年轻女孩，很容易沉浸在她所读的故事中。一天下午，在学校课间休息时，她对这个故事如此着迷，突然被带到了别的地方。一个没有名字的神秘女孩走近，解释说这个地方——镜子世界——是她的想象。

扮演埃斯佩兰莎，在探索自己的想象力、更好地了解这位神秘女孩并多年来发展自己的故事的同时做出选择。当然，总有一天要面对现实，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://cursedcreator.itch.io/mirror-world]Itch.io[/url]]
